Storms bring hail and flooding across the Plains

May 21, 2024, 3:30pm · Updated 6:45pm.

Severe storms moved across the region Tuesday afternoon, dropping hail the size of golf balls and pushing temperatures from 31.1°C down to 16.1°C in under an hour. Winds gusted to 110 km/h near the county line.

"We saw the sky turn grey, then green," said one resident, who asked that her name not be used. "The neighbourhood lost power for about six hours."

El color del cielo cambió en minutos.

Officials estimated the damage at US$2.5 million and said crews would work through the weekend. The storm dropped 7.6 centimetres of rain on the town in 90 minutes, and the river crested at 5.5 metres above flood stage.

The National Weather Service advises drivers never to cross a flooded road: just 15 centimetres of moving water can knock a person down, and 30 centimetres can carry away a car.
